questions.question: C1, C2 and C3 can do a work alone in 10, 12 and 15 days respectively. All three of them began the work together but C2 left 2 days before the completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given**

C1's rate = 1/10 per day, C2's rate = 1/12 per day, C3's rate = 1/15 per day

**Formula:**

Total time = total work/combined rate of work

**Solution:**

⇒ The combined rate of C1, C2, and C3 = 1/10 + 1/12 + 1/15 = 1/4 per day

⇒ Since C2 left 2 days earlier, the work done in those 2 days = 2 (1/10 + 1/15) = 1/3

⇒ Remaining work = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3

⇒ Time to complete the remaining work = 2/3 / 1/4 = 8/3 days

⇒ Total time = 2 + 8/3 = 14/3 days

**Therefore, the work was completed in (14/3) days.**

questions.question: In A mixture of 180 litres, the ratio of milk and water is 5 ∶ 1. If this ratio is to be 3 ∶ 2, then find the quantity of water to be further added.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Total mixture = 180 litres, Current ratio of milk and water = 5 : 1

**Formula:**

Quantity of water to be added = (new water quantity - current water quantity)

**Solution:**

⇒ Current quantity of water = 1/6 × 180 = 30 litres

⇒ If the new ratio is 3:2, total mixture = 180 + x (where x is the quantity of water to be added)

⇒ New quantity of milk = 3/5 × (180 + x) = 108 + 0.6x

⇒ As the quantity of milk remains the same, 108 + 0.6x = 150

⇒ x = (150 - 108)/0.6 = 70 litres

**Therefore, 70 litres of water need to be added.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 400. It is sold for Rs. 300 . If there is a loss of 15%, then by what percent above the cost is the article marked?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Marked price = Rs 400, Selling price = Rs 300, Loss = 15%

**Formula:**

Cost price = Selling price/(1 - Loss %), Marked % above the cost = (Marked price - Cost price)/Cost price

**Solution:**

⇒ Cost price = 300/(1 - 0.15) = Rs 352.94

⇒ Marked % above the cost = (400 - 352.94)/352.94 = 0.1333 (or 13.33%)

**Therefore, the article is marked 13.33% above the cost.**

questions.question: Ajay can row his boat in still water, at a speed of 11 km/hr. If the speed of the stream is 7 km/hr, how long will it take to a distance of 54 km downstream?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Ajay in still water = 11 km/hr,

Speed of stream = 7 km/hr,

Distance = 54 km

**Formula:**

Time = distance/speed,

Speed downstream = Speed in still water + Speed of stream

**Solution:**

⇒ Speed downstream = 11 + 7 = 18 km/hr

⇒ Time = 54/18 = 3 hours

**Therefore, it will take Ajay 3 hours to cover a distance of 54 km downstream.**

questions.question: The volume of a hemisphere is 486π cm³. Find the radius.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Volume of a hemisphere = 486π cm³

**Formula:**

Volume of a hemisphere = 2/3πr³

**Solution:**

⇒ Solving the formula for r gives r = (3 × volume/2π)⁽¹/³⁾

⇒ r = (3 × 486π/2π)⁽¹/³⁾ = 9 cm

**Therefore, the radius of the hemisphere is 9 cm.**

questions.question: A man buys 13 pens for a rupee. How many pens should he sell for a rupee to earn a profit of 30 percent?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Buy 13 pens for 1 rupee, sell x pens for 1 rupee, profit = 30%

**Formula:**

Selling price = (100 + profit%)/cost price

**Solution:**

⇒ Cost price per pen = 1/13 rupees, desired selling price per pen = 1/x rupees

⇒ Selling price = (100 + 30)/(1/13) = 10/13 rupees

⇒ 10/13 = 1/x

⇒ x = 13/10 = 10 pens

**Therefore, he should sell 10 pens for a rupee to earn a profit of 30 percent.**

questions.question: What will be the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P = Rs. 64000

r = 5% per annum = 5/100 = 0.05 (in decimal)

n = 1 (as the interest is compounded annually)

t = 2 years

**Calculation:**

A = 64000(1 + 0.05/1)²

= 64000(1.05)²

= 64000 × 1.1025

= Rs. 70560

So, the total amount after 2 years would be Rs. 70560.

Interest = A - P

= 70560 - 64000

= Rs. 6560

**Therefore, the compound interest accrued on a sum of Rs. 64000 at the rate of 5% per annum in 2 years, compounded annually, will be Rs. 6560.**

questions.question: If the third proportion of 3 and x is 27 and the third proportion of 2 and y is 8, then find x ∶ y.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Third proportion of 3 and x is 27, third proportion of 2 and y is 8.

**Concept: **

The third proportion of a and b is given by (b²/a).

**Calculation:**

For 3 and x, we have x²/3 = 27 ⇒ x = √(27 × 3) ⇒ x = 9

For 2 and y, we have y²/2 = 8 ⇒ y = √(8 × 2) ⇒ y = 4

**Therefore, the ratio x : y = 9 : 4. **

questions.question: Average marks obtained by 19 boys of a college is 48. If the highest marks and lowest marks obtained are removed, then the average reduces by 4. What is the average of the highest and lowest marks obtained?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average marks of 19 boys is 48. After removing highest and lowest marks, average of 17 boys is 44.

**Concept **

Average = Total Marks/Number of Students.

**Calculation:**

Total marks of 19 boys = 19 × 48 = 912

Total marks of 17 boys = 17 × 44 = 748

The sum of the highest and lowest marks = 912 - 748 = 164

The average of the highest and lowest marks = 164/2 = 82

**Hence, the average of the highest and lowest marks is 82.**

questions.question: The price of a mobile is Rs. 30,000. The value of the mobile depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and at the end of next year, it depreciates by 15%. What will be the value of the mobile after 2 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Price of a mobile = Rs. 30,000. It depreciates by 12% at the end of the first year and 15% at the end of the second year.

**Concept:**

Depreciation is calculated by taking a certain percentage off the value at the start of each year.

**Calculation:**

After the first year, the value = 30,000 × (1 - 12/100) ⇒ Rs. 26,400

After the second year, the value = 26,400 × (1 - 15/100) ⇒ Rs. 22,440

**Hence, the value of the mobile after 2 years is Rs. 22,440. **

questions.question: Tripti can construct a divider alone in 4 days while Rajan can construct it alone in 3 days. If they construct it together and get a payment of Rs. 14000, then what is Tripti's share?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Tripti can construct a divider alone in 4 days, Rajan in 3 days. Total payment = Rs. 14,000.

**Concept:**

The share of each person is proportional to the amount of work they do.

**Calculation:**

Tripti's work rate = 1/4 per day

Rajan's work rate = 1/3 per day

Total work rate = 1/4 + 1/3 ⇒ 7/12 per day

Therefore, Tripti's share = Rs. 14,000 × (1/4 ÷ 7/12) ⇒ Rs. 6,000

**Hence, Tripti's share is Rs. 6,000.**

questions.question: The average weight of 9 boxes is 61 kg. If three boxes having an average weight of 70 kg are removed, then what will be the new average weight of the remaining boxes?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Deviation of removed boxes from the initial average = 70 − 61 = 9 kg.

Total excess weight removed = 3 × 9 = 27 kg.

This excess weight is taken away from the remaining 6 boxes.

Decrease in the average of remaining boxes = 27 ÷ 6 = 4.5 kg.

New average = 61 − 4.5 = 56.5 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 56.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of 9 boxes = 61 kg

Number of boxes removed = 3

Average weight of removed boxes = 70 kg

**Formula Used:**

Sum of values = Average × Number of items

New Average = Sum of remaining values ÷ Number of remaining items

 

 Total 9 Boxes × 61 kg = 549 kg
 
 
 3 Boxes (Removed)
 3 × 70 = 210 kg

 
 6 Remaining Boxes
 6 × New Avg = 339 kg

 New Average = 339 ÷ 6 = 56.5 kg

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of all 9 boxes = 9 × 61 = 549 kg

⇒ Total weight of 3 removed boxes = 3 × 70 = 210 kg

⇒ Number of remaining boxes = 9 − 3 = 6

⇒ Total weight of remaining 6 boxes = 549 − 210 = 339 kg

⇒ New average weight = 339 ÷ 6 = 56.5 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 56.5 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂). This formula is highly useful for directly finding the total average when two different groups are combined.

Net Deviation Method

Net change in sum ÷ Total entities = Change in average. If a leaving group has a higher average than the original, the remaining group's average strictly decreases.

Replacement in Averages

When an item is replaced by a new one, Weight of New Item = Weight of Old Item + (Total items × Increase in average).
</p
